assertions.assertion: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring was performed with CPT code 93229
The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered for extended ambulatory assessment to characterize the arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The payer letter acknowledges that this decision does not preclude the provider from submitting a corrected claim if valid authorization is subsequently secured
